headline: SpaceX Swings to Profit as Starlink and AI Revenues Double
summary: SpaceX reported a net profit as surging spending on artificial intelligence was outweighed by more than doubled revenue from its Starlink satellite internet and AI products.
why: SpaceX is a private aerospace manufacturer and satellite communications provider whose financial performance reflects rapid commercial growth in space-based infrastructure.

impacts.name: Aerospace and Satellite
impacts.why: Rapid revenue growth from satellite internet services demonstrates commercial viability in commercial space operations.
